historical_commentary.text: This note covers how record-selection Sets were created and maintained in the new 4D V6 language, and compatibility considerations for routines migrating from V3 databases; Sets remain a supported classic-language concept in current 4D, so the general topic is still conceptually relevant, though the V6-specific compatibility concerns described are now purely historical since that particular V3-to-V6 migration window has long since closed.
related_updates: 4D's classic Sets (compact in-memory representations of record selections with fast logical operations) remain part of the current 4D language, though modern development also commonly uses entity selections (ORDA) for similar purposes
The specific V3-to-V6 set-compatibility concerns this note addresses are no longer applicable since that migration path is decades in the past
